bio: Escape the every day to this charming North Yorkshire estate for the ultimate, quintessential dining experience. Crathorne Hall provides the perfect setting to indulge in Afternoon Tea while taking in the estate's far-reaching views offered by ceiling-high windows.  Afternoon Tea at Crathorne Hall Hotel is served in the Edwardian Room, with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. This elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  Crathorne Hall Hotel are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?
